rows.name: value
rows.description: Controlled value, or null for no selection.

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Fired with the new date (or null when cleared).

rows.name: display
rows.description: Text input + popover calendar, or an always-visible inline calendar.

rows.name: minDate
rows.description: Earliest selectable date. Defaults to tomorrow (future-only); override to set a different floor.

rows.name: rangeError
rows.description: Message shown when an out-of-range date is typed (popover).
